caption: The drawing depicts a tall wooden chest of drawers with a two-part construction; the upper section is slightly narrower than the lower section. The chest is brown with realistic wood grain texture and consists of eight drawers in total—four on the upper section (with three horizontal drawers and one smaller central drawer decorated with a fan-shaped carved motif), and four large horizontal drawers on the lower section. The drawers feature brass handle pulls, and keyholes are centered on each drawer. The top of the upper section has a broken arch pediment with a central circular area, and the sides sweep upward in a double curve with scroll-like ends. The entire chest stands on four bracket feet. There are no other objects or decorative elements present in the image; the background is plain and neutral.
title: Chest-on-Chest
